notes_en: Fix: Home/Quran tabs crashed with 'Null check operator used on a null value' (MaterialLocalizations.of returned null). Root cause: MaterialApp used DefaultMaterialLocalizations.delegate which only supports English, but the app sets locale to Urdu/Arabic. Switched all three MaterialApps in main.dart to GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegate / GlobalWidgetsLocalizations.delegate (flutter_localizations), which support ur/ar/en.
notes_ur: درست: ہوم/قرآن ٹیب کریش (MaterialLocalizations null)۔ اب گلوبل لوکلائزیشن ڈیلیگیٹ استعمال ہو رہے ہیں (اردو/عربی/انگریزی)。
notes_hi: Fix: Home/Quran tab crash (MaterialLocalizations null). Ab Global localization delegates use ho rahe hain (ur/ar/en).
